task_completion.description: Launch Screaming Frog SEO Spider and enter the target URL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screaming Frog window is open with 'https://books.toscrape.com/' entered in the 'Enter URL to spider' field.

task_completion.description: Attempt to configure the sitemap for the audit.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen in the 'Configuration > Spider > Crawl' or 'Sitemaps' tab, or attempting to add the sitemap URL 'https://books.toscrape.com/sitemap.xml'.

task_completion.description: Execute the crawl of the website.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The progress bar in Screaming Frog shows the crawl reaching 100% and the 'Internal' tab is populated with URLs from the domain.

task_completion.description: Export the 'Orphan Pages' and 'Internal HTML' reports as CSV files to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent uses the 'Export' button or 'Bulk Export' menu. A file explorer window or terminal command shows 'orphan_pages.csv' and 'internal_html.csv' (or similar names) in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.

task_completion.description: Create the summary report text file with required metrics and sitemap status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows 'orphan_pages_report.txt' in '~/Documents/SEO/reports/' containing the total URLs, orphan count, and a note that the sitemap was unavailable/missing.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI rather than just command-line scripts to simulate the audit.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Screaming Frog application window, mouse movements, and menu interactions.

integrity.description: The data in the reports reflects the actual crawl of books.toscrape.com.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Internal' tab in the GUI shows URLs like 'https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/...' and not placeholder or generic data.

integrity.description: The agent correctly identifies and reports the sitemap as missing rather than hallucinating its contents.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final report or Screaming Frog 'Sitemaps' tab shows a 404 error or a 'No sitemap found' message.
